trap.label: remember doing ≠ to do
trap.wrong: I remember to see her last year at school.
trap.right: I remember seeing her last year at school.
trap.why: Em português "lembrei de ver" mistura lembrança e tarefa. Em inglês: remember doing = lembrar de algo que fez; remember to do = lembrar de fazer algo.

mcq.q: Complete: I'll never forget **___** the sea.

fix.wrong: I don't remember to give you the key.
fix.right: I don't remember giving you the key.

fix.wrong: She forgot calling him, so he was angry.
fix.right: She forgot to call him, so he was angry.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva (lembrança): “I remember. I met her in 2010.”
Passe para a negativa: “She remembered to call.”
